newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli bus attacked in W. Bank - security sources.
newsitem.headline: Israeli bus attacked in W. Bank - security sources.

text.p: A bomb exploded near an Israeli bus in the West Bank on Wednesday, wounding at least one person, security sources said.
The sources said Jewish seminary students were in the vehicle and that the incident occurred near the West Bank town of Nablus.
Israel Radio said an explosive charge blew up near an army jeep guarding the bus carrying the seminary students on a road inside Israeli-controlled territory near Nablus.
Israel handed over Nablus to Palestinian self-rule under its interim peace deals with the PLO but maintained control of a Jewish shrine called Joseph's Tomb in the city.
The attack came as Israel's defence minister and a top PLO official met near Tel Aviv for talks, with U.S. and Egyptian mediation, on resuming formal peace negotiations.
Tensions have been high in the West Bank since Israel began work on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem in March.
